requirements_summary: Mid-market SaaS (product analytics) wants to migrate from current LLM API provider to Redwood Hosted first, then transition to Dedicated for predictable throughput and data residency. Primary workloads: in-app assistant + embeddings for document search + automated summarization. Targets: 90th pct latency < 250ms for short chat turns, embeddings throughput 200 QPS, cost sensitivity focused on per-token economics and predictable monthly commit. Needs OpenAI-compatible interface (compat layer) to minimize app changes, strong regression testing to ensure prompt parity across generation and multi-turn state, and auditability (audit logs + KMS). EU data residency mandatory for subset of customers. Must support SSO and SOC2 compliance for procurement.
